title: 中国早餐宇宙④完结·西安肉夹馍：一个馍，夹了两千年 | Xi'an Rou Jia Mo 🥙
description:
肉夹馍你点肥瘦，还是纯瘦？评论区报答案。

【中国早餐宇宙·第4集 西安·完结】一个馍，夹了两千年。肉夹馍其实是「肉夹于馍」的省略——馍是白吉馍，肉是腊汁肉。腊汁肉历史可追到秦代、约两千年前，战国时叫「寒肉」，产在秦晋豫三角的韩国，秦灭韩后做法传进长安；隋唐称「馍夹肉」，明清走上街头。白吉馍讲究「铁圈虎背菊花心」，皮薄松脆、内心软绵。真正合二为一是近代：1904 年蓝田人樊炳仁到西安沿街卖腊汁肉，儿子樊凤祥见挑夫单手不便吃饭，便把肉与馍合起来，做成单手就能拿着吃的一只——这才有了今天的肉夹馍。

One flatbread, filled for two millennia. "Rou jia mo" is short for "meat clasped in the bun" — a crisp white-ji bun around sauce-stewed meat. The meat traces to the Qin era ~2,000 years ago; in the Warring States it was "han rou," and the technique reached Chang'an after Qin conquered the Han state. The bun prizes its "iron ring, tiger back, chrysanthemum heart" — thin, crisp, fluffy within. The one-handed sandwich we know came in 1904, when the Fan family, selling stewed meat to porters in Xi'an, joined meat and bun into one. A crunchy bite, a rush of juices — the finale of our four-city breakfast tour.

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Food folklore, not dietary advice. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
